title: Momcozy Bottle Brush Kit Pro, Innovative Push-Press Deep Cleaning Baby Set
bullets: 【Push-Press Foam, Easier Cleaning】- Press to dispense foam directly to the brush for quicker, easier bottle cleaning with less effort. The upgraded twist-on soap dispenser stays securely in place for smoother pressing and dispensing. Typically 3–5 presses are enough for one bottle. Try it with Momcozy Bottle Cleaning Liquid for even richer foam and an easier clean.

【Longer Reach, Better Control】Upgraded from 26.5 cm to 28 cm with a longer grip area, the extended brush reaches deeper into tall and deep bottles while giving you better control during everyday cleaning.

【Wider Head, Fuller Contact】A wider, tapered head and thicker bristles improve contact for more effective cleaning across most bottle sizes. Soft silicone remains gentle on bottle surfaces for scratch-free cleaning.

【One Kit For More Cleaning Jobs】Designed for most common baby bottle sizes and shapes, the kit includes tools for bottles, breast pump parts, nipples, straws and other hard-to-reach feeding accessories—so one set can handle more of your daily cleaning routine.

【Baby-Safe & Travel-Ready】Made with food-grade silicone and free from BPA and phthalates. The detachable design packs neatly into the included travel bag, making the full cleaning kit easy to take along for family visits, weekends away and travel.
